blocks.text: To edit a VPN user enablement rule:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > VPN (for Legacy Apps) > User Enablement.
Locate the user enablement rule you want to modify, and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: If you only want to change a user enablement rule's place in the Rule Order, you can manually enter a new value on the User Enablement page.

blocks.item: In the Edit User Enablement window, modify fields as necessary. For more information about each field, see Configuring VPN User Enablement Rules.
